Add Voidhash to the app in this directory, from nothing to a checked integration.

The CLI does what needs no knowledge of your code: it finds out what kind of app this is, signs you
in, chooses or creates the project, creates the perk, product or location you ask for, installs the
SDK with your package manager, and writes voidhash.json, the SDK client or environment values, and
the generated types.

A coding agent you already have (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build, Cursor or fx) then does
what needs your code read: mounting the SDK where the app starts, identifying the user, gating on a
perk, selling a product. It runs without its own interface and with your own account, may run your
project's own checks but install nothing, and is kept to this directory and off .env files as far as
that agent can be; the plan says how far, before anything runs. Its whole task is written to
.voidhash/integrate/task.md first, so you can read what it is told. With no such agent, or --agent
none, the task is written for you to hand to any agent or to follow yourself; run the command again
afterwards to check the result.

Then the CLI checks the result instead of taking the agent's word: your typecheck or build must
pass, the SDK must be in your code, and, when you start the app, its first event must arrive. The
summary lists the files git shows as changed and what is left for you, such as store setup. Nothing
is committed.

It needs a clean git working tree, so that everything it changes can be reviewed and undone;
--allow-dirty lifts that. Run it again at any time: it continues an interrupted run and repeats
nothing that is already done. --restart forgets the earlier run.

Platforms:
  expo, nextjs, react       supported
  react-native, web, node,  best effort: the same steps, with less of the
  ios, android              result checked

Usage:
  voidhash integrate [flags]

Aliases:
  integrate, wizard

Flags:
      --agent <claude|codex|opencode|grok|cursor|fx|none>
                             The coding agent that edits your code, or none to write its task only
                             (default: the one installed; asks in a terminal when there are several)
      --allow-dirty          Run although git shows uncommitted changes, or this is not a git
                             repository
      --check <check>        A command that must pass, instead of the project's typecheck or build
                             (can be repeated)
      --dry-run              Show what would happen, and change nothing
  -h, --help                 Show help for this command
      --json                 Print the result as JSON, for scripts
      --location <location>  The slug of the paywall location the app presents; created when the
                             project has none by it
      --mcp                  Also add the Voidhash MCP server to your AI agents (default: asks in a
                             terminal)
      --model <model>        The model the agent works with, named as that agent names its models
                             (default: the one the agent is set up with)
      --perk <perk>          The slug of the perk the app gates on; created when the project has
                             none by it
      --platform <expo|react-native|nextjs|react|web|ios|android|node>
                             The kind of app, when it is not the one found
      --product <product>    The slug of the product the app sells; created as a monthly
                             subscription when the project has none by it
      --project <project>    The project to integrate: its slug, organization/slug, name or id
                             (default: the one voidhash.json names, else asks)
      --restart              Forget an earlier run here and start over
      --timeout <timeout>    How long the agent may work
      --wait <wait>          How long to wait for the app's first event, such as 5m (default: asks
                             in a terminal, otherwise does not wait)
  -y, --yes                  Go ahead without asking, with the defaults for what is not passed

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash integrate
  voidhash integrate --dry-run
  voidhash integrate --project acme/app --perk premium --product pro_monthly --yes
  voidhash integrate --agent none
  voidhash integrate --project acme/app --agent codex --yes --json
